subject: Proposal: Capacity Uplift & Term Alignment — Contingency for Rivals' Bake-Off
messages:
From: Sanjay Ram <sanjay.ram@brightroute.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity & pricing for 2029 expansion

Hi Alex / Marissa,

We're starting to finalize our 2029 inference commitments and wanted to reach out before we lock in anything with the other vendors. We have incoming pressure from procurement and engineering — a competitor (unnamed at the moment) is pushing a bake-off and offering a shorter-term pilot + aggressive pricing.

Top asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide an uplift plan for Q3/Q4 2029 capacity (roughly 4x current committed throughput)?
- What term options do you recommend (12 / 18 / 24 months) and any rate cards for those commits?
- Can we get a short performance baseline to show to our SREs for the bake-off?

Procurement wants something on our desk by next Friday (3/24) — appreciate any fast lane you can provide. I've attached our SLO summary for reference.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Ram
VP Engineering, BrightRoute Logistics
[attachment: BR_SLOs.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>
To: Sanjay Ram <sanjay.ram@brightroute.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 12:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity & pricing for 2029 expansion

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the heads up. We can move quickly on this.

Quick response: Redwood can support a 4x committed uplift (dedicated pool) and we recommend an 18-month alignment for stability and predictable unit costs. As a starter we can offer an 10% list discount off our hosted rate for an 18-month commit and truth around performance by providing a two-week trial on a dedicated pool with your test corpus.

I'm attaching an initial uplift offer (uplift_offer_v1.pdf) with rough price points and capacity tiers. To make the bake-off effective we need your baseline traces or a synthetic prompt set — the BR_SLOs you attached is helpful, but we'll need token-level distribution for a realistic run. Can procurement connect us to the SRE who owns the test harness?

I can jump on a quick call later today if that helps.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: uplift_offer_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sanjay Ram <sanjay.ram@brightroute.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@brightroute.com
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity & pricing for 2029 expansion

Alex — thanks. Attaching token distribution and a short list of the top prompt families our customers run (BR_SLOs.xlsx). Procurement is pushing for a 12-month term with either a pilot or short trial to satisfy legal. They are explicitly wary of multi-year lock-ins without a hands-on test.

If you can offer:
- A 2-week free trial on a dedicated pool with our workload, and
- A clear rollback / fallback plan if performance doesn't hit baseline,

then procurement will consider proposing Redwood internally as the favoured vendor. Can you confirm the SLA floor and the mitigation steps you'd take during a trial?

Sanjay
[attachment: BR_SLOs.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: BrightRoute — save playbook + immediate asks

Team — quick internal plan to respond to the bake-off and procurement push. High level we present three paths to the customer and let them pick the one that satisfies procurement and SREs: 

1) Commitment Upsell: 18-month term, 4x capacity, price at 10% off list. Include guaranteed reserved pool and capacity ramp schedule.
2) Trial + Bench: Two-week dedicated trial with our bench harness (we provide the harness + run two synthetic runs; results co-signed by BrightRoute SRE). If trial meets baseline, convert to 18-month commitment with a 12% conversion credit (effective discount).
3) Risk-Mitigation: Short-term 12-month contract plus a fallback plan (regional burst capacity + pre-warmed fallback pool) that reduces migration pain.

Immediate asks (owners):
- Alex: produce final offer doc with clear pricing and DocuSign link (deadline 3/24 COB).
- Vivek: prepare bench harness image and synthetic run commands; estimate token-hour cost for a 2-week run.
- Monica: draft customer-facing SLA summary and rollback steps.

Attaching a save playbook draft for structure (save_playbook.md). Keep it tight — procurement wants concise bullets, not an essay.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
[attachment: save_playbook.md (text)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>
To: Sanjay Ram <sanjay.ram@brightroute.com>, procurement@brightroute.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 24 Mar 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Offer: 18-month uplift + free 2-week trial (summary + next steps)

Hi Sanjay / BrightRoute procurement — following our internal alignment, here is a concrete offer that matches the paths Marissa outlined and keeps you away from a disruptive replatform: 

Offer summary:
- Commit: 18-month term, reserved dedicated pool sized at ~4x current throughput (estimated 1200 concurrent token RPS peak).
- Pricing: 12% effective discount if you take the trial path (we'll apply a conversion credit after successful trial). Otherwise 10% off list for direct 18-month sign-up.
- SLA: 99.95% regional uptime, 10ms median token latency (measured on the agreed harness); detailed SLA summary attached.
- Trial: 2-week dedicated trial starting on mutual availability; Redwood covers trial infrastructure fees up to $20k.
- Rollback / Mitigation: We provide a pre-warmed fallback pool in a secondary region and a staged traffic switchback plan documented in the attached SLA summary.

Next steps / links:
- Bench harness invite (we'll provision and send credentials once you accept): https://bench.redwood.com/invite/RDW-78321
- DocuSign (offer + SOW): https://docusign.com/link/rdw-78321-offer

Attachments: uplift_offer_final.pdf, bench_harness_invite.txt

If this matches what procurement needs, I can have DocuSign out within 24 hours and Vivek will stand up the harness for the trial. Happy to hop on a 30-min call Monday to walk through the SLA language.

Thanks,
— Alex
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0183
redwood.inference | sales@redwood.inference
